name: Glue
text: Glue Glue 1 target object or treasure in place. While this spell lasts, the glued target cannot be picked up or moved. This spell cannot be cast on a carried item or carried treasure. A 3

name: Handful of Tacks
text: Handful of Tacks Trinket Can be dropped in 1 empty square to fill that square with tacks. Any wizard or creature entering a square filled with tacks suffers 3 physical damage. This spell is not an attack and cannot be evaded. A wizard or creature starting its turn adjacent to a tack-filled square may spend its entire Move and Cast phase picking up the tacks to re-use later. If dropped tacks are affected by a Water spell, they are washed away and destroyed. 3

name: Booby Trap
text: Booby Trap Creation Look at the 4 trap tokens and place them facedown on 4 different empty squares on the game board. If an enemy wizard or creature enters a square with a trap token, flip the token faceup. If it shows a trap, the wizard or creature suffers 4 magical damage (this is not an attack). Then, discard all trap tokens and this spell ends: If the trap token is blank, discard it. If dispelled, each trap token must be dispelled separately.

name: Dust Cloud
text: Dust Cloud Creation Fill 1 empty square with a cloud of dust that obscures sight. The Dust Cloud blocks  and wizards and creatures in the square have no  except to themselves and the Dust Cloud itself. Wizards and creatures may enter the square normally, but each one attempting to leave the square must roll a die to randomly determine in which direction it moves. A die result that causes the wizard or creature to bump into a wall costs 1 movement point, and the wizard or creature remains in the square. The target may try to move again as long as it has movement points to do so. A

name: Thornbush
